timing_reference: Preserve complete native waveform and full RIR tail. Internal VITS allocations remain generation references, not acoustic/phonetic truth; store prefix and container end separately.
quality: Original native/full-render mechanical quality policies; full pack fails on any failure, no filtering/retry/resynthesis.
authorization: Rendering contract registration only. New separate generator and code/source/version/quality/overlap/timing lock required before generation; scoring not authorized.
selection: Existing fixed grid/gates/rank unchanged. No acceptance generation/media access.
limits: Development RIR chosen before any development synthesis/inference. Different delays and amplitudes from training, synthetic coverage only; no physical-room independence or TTS pretraining independence claim.
